Options:
  --dev  Add a development dependency
  --optional EXTRA  Add to an optional dependency group
  --group GROUP  Add to a dependency group
  --editable  Use editable installation
  --no-sync  Do not synchronize the environment
  --locked  Require an unchanged lockfile
  --rev REV  Select a Git revision
  --python PYTHON  Select a Python interpreter
  --offline  Disable network access
  --no-cache  Disable caching
  --directory DIRECTORY  Change working directory
  --project PROJECT  Select project directory
